content: Welcome to skateboarding camp. Are you ready to sign up?
I want to, but I don't a skateboard. I prefer to ride my bike.
Well, we have skate parks and biking parks here.
Sounds great, but I don't have any protective equipment.
We have all the safety equipment you'll need.
Great. How much is the camp?

If you sign up for one week,it's $600, but if you sign up for 2 weeks, the price drops down to $500 per week. Housing and 3 meals a day are also included in the weekly price. We also have a professional skateboarder coming to the winter camp. The camp is only offered during the summer or winter.
Great. I also have a special VIP card for this summer's camp. Will that save me even more money?
Nope, the VIP card is for the winter camp.
We cannot afford the winter camp so I guess we'll see you this summer.
